name: Bugs Bunny Builders
description: At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage an inept crew of builders. By working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety, and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

videos.title: Haunted Garage
videos.overview: It's Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

videos.title: Lunar New Year
videos.overview: The crew celebrates the Lunar New Year and Bugs and Lola go missing during the Lion Dance.

videos.title: Don't Be Fooled By His Size
videos.overview: Tweety Bird uses his crane to lift stuff in this music video as he helps his crew get the job done.

videos.title: Bugs Bunny Boogie
videos.overview: Bugs Bunny uses his excavator to dig in this music video as he tackles looney jobs across town.

videos.title: Porky Perfect
videos.overview: Porky Pig uses his steamroller to flatten and make sure every build is "Porky Perfect" in this music video.

videos.title: Buckle Up
videos.overview: A music video of Lola Bunny using her bulldozer to move things as she oversees various looney builds.

videos.title: Hard Hat Time
videos.overview: An action-packed music video of The Looney Builders traveling across land, air, and sea to get the job done.

videos.title: Awesome Duck
videos.overview: A music video of Daffy Duck using his dump truck to haul supplies and goof around on the job.

videos.title: Lunch Break
videos.overview: Porky tries to eat his sandwich but keeps getting interrupted by the crew who need his help.

videos.title: Daffy's Spa
videos.overview: Daffy invites everyone to take a relaxing mud bath that turns out to be anything but.

videos.title: Lemonade
videos.overview: Tweety spots a giant lemon in a tree and is determined to make lemonade for everyone.

videos.title: Car Wash
videos.overview: Lola oversees the car wash but soon realizes that she misassigned the tasks.

videos.title: Hide N' Seek
videos.overview: The crew plays Hide N’ Seek at headquarters and Tweety is the seeker.

videos.title: Boogie Button
videos.overview: Bugs tries to play music for the crew on their lunch break, but his “boogie button” is busted.

videos.title: Splash Zone
videos.overview: Mayor Foghorn Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a giant water slide for Looneyburg’s waterpark. He keeps adding onto the design with the support of Bugs until problems arise.

videos.title: Ice Creamed
videos.overview: It’s Taz’s birthday, so The Looney Builders build him a huge ice cream sundae. Porky worries about making a mistake and delays the build causing the ice cream to start to melt.

videos.title: Race Track Race
videos.overview: The Looney Builders race against the clock to build Cecil Turtle a new racetrack. Daffy gets caught up in his own desire to race and changes part of the build.

videos.title: Dino Fright
videos.overview: George P. Mandrake hires The Looney Builders to build a T. Rex fossil. It’s Tweety’s job to place the bones with his crane, but his fear of the big dino affects his ability to get the job done.

videos.title: Snow Cap
videos.overview: Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build her a home in Looneyburg. Lola soon discovers they got the design wrong and the crew has to make adjustments.

videos.title: Tweety-Go-Round
videos.overview: Tweety leads The Looney Builders in building a new merry-go-round at the park for the kids. His crane breaks down and his small size affects his ability to contribute to the build.

videos.title: Smash House
videos.overview: The Looney Builders learn that Taz accidentally destroyed his house, so they set out to build him a new one that’s smash-proof.

videos.title: Play Day
videos.overview: When the Looney Builders build themselves a playground, Daffy gets so excited about his section that he takes all the supplies for himself.

videos.title: Rock On
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac and Tosh Gopher to build them a home underground. Daffy can’t remove rocks from the area fast enough and fails to ask for help.

videos.title: Buzz In
videos.overview: Bizzy Buzzard’s mom hires The Looney Builders to build her family a new nest. Bizzy wants to help but keeps getting in the way creating all sorts of problems for the crew.

videos.title: Stories
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Hoots Talon to expand and paint the old library. They enlist master painter Sylvester who faces his fear of heights with his build buddy, Tweety.

videos.title: Cheesy Peasy
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by the Mouse Sisters to build a bridge over a mac and cheese spill. Lola turns the job into a game which results in the crew losing sight of the bigger goal.

videos.title: Looney Science
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build a science museum in the desert where Wile E. Coyote becomes distracted by the Road Runner.

videos.title: Big Feet
videos.overview: Mayor Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a water wheel in the forest where Porky worries about a mythical creature named "Big Feet."

videos.title: Squirreled Away
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build Tibs Squirrel a closet in his tree, but it won't fit all of Tibs' stuff and he doesn't want to get rid of anything.

videos.title: Beach Battle
videos.overview: When The Looney Builders enter a sandcastle building contest, Tweety sees the competition and loses confidence in his idea.

videos.title: Game Time
videos.overview: Chef Hector hires The Looney Builders to build him a burger restaurant, but Daffy is so focused on beating his handheld game that he causes major setbacks.

videos.title: Soup Up
videos.overview: As The Looney Builders help Petunia build a greenhouse, she can't wait for the veggies to grow and does everything she can to speed up the process.

videos.title: Looneyburg Lights
videos.overview: The Looney Builders prepare to host a big holiday lights festival in Looneyburg Park when an unexpected snowstorm prevents Looneyburgers from attending.

videos.title: Blast Off
videos.overview: When Marvin the Martian crash lands in Looneyburg, he's in a hurry to leave and hires The Looney Builders to build him a spaceship.

videos.title: K-9: Space Puppy
videos.overview: Marvin the Martian hires The Looney Builders to build a doghouse on Mars for his puppy, K-9. Daffy soon bonds with K-9 and comes up with a plan to prolong their playtime.

videos.title: Cousin Billy
videos.overview: When Daffy's cool cousin Billy hires The Looney Builders to build her an art studio, Daffy tries to show off to prove how cool he is.

videos.title: Cheddar Days
videos.overview: The Mouse Sisters hire The Looney Builders to build a cheese café featuring a mural by Sylvester who is having a bad day.

videos.title: Taz Recycle
videos.overview: When The Looney Builders build Taz a wrecking ball vehicle, he struggles to learn how to operate it.

videos.title: Sea School
videos.overview: The Looney Builders face underwater challenges as they build a sea school for Moxie Manatee.

videos.title: Underwater Star
videos.overview: Moxie Manatee hires The Looney Builders to build an obstacle course for the Sandy Shells Preschool Games, but Lola isn't listening to her crew.

videos.title: Party Boat
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build a party boat for Mac and Tosh when Tweety accidentally makes a mistake but doesn't ask for help.

videos.title: Mail Whale
videos.overview: The Looney Builders try to help Winston Whale by building him a mail truck, but Winston is used to working alone.

videos.title: Bright Light
videos.overview: When Mayor Foghorn Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a lighthouse for Looneyburg, Lola's tablet breaks and she must rely on herself.

videos.title: Mini Golf
videos.overview: The Looney Builders redesign the final hole of ACME Acres Mini Golf Course, and Porky is determined to get it just right for the kids.

videos.title: Goofballs
videos.overview: The Beaver Brothers hire The Looney Builders to build them a log cabin, but soon sidetrack the job by goofing around too much.

videos.title: Skate Park
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build a skate park for the kids, but it soon interferes with Hoots Talon and his friends' activities.

videos.title: Batty Kathy
videos.overview: As The Looney Builders build Kathy Bat an upside-down radio station, Porky has concerns but doesn't speak up.

videos.title: Honey Bunny
videos.overview: Queen Beatrice hires The Looney Builders to build a workshop in her beehive where there is one rule the crew has trouble following.

videos.title: Castle Hassle
videos.overview: Prince Lionel of England hires The Looney Builders to build him a party room for his birthday, then proceeds to boss the crew around.

videos.title: Catwalk
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Penelope Pussycat to build a fashion runway in France where they are encouraged to make their design bigger and more fun.

videos.title: Dim Sum
videos.overview: Chef Poyung Panda hires The Looney Builders to build her a Dim Sum bus in China. The crew faces a major setback and Bugs worries about letting down his favorite chef.

videos.title: Crane Game
videos.overview: As The Looney Builders build a giant claw game for Chibi Critter's arcade in Japan, they discover the claw part is broken.

videos.title: Speedy
videos.overview: The Looney Builders rush to build a soccer stadium in Mexico for their fast customer, Speedy Gonzalez.

videos.title: The Easter Bunnies
videos.overview: The Easter Bunny is sick, so she hires The Looney Builders to take over the festivities and ensure Looneyburg has a great Easter.

videos.title: Junior
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Ma and Pa Bear to build a bedroom for their son, Junior, whose excitement causes setbacks.

videos.title: Looney Moon
videos.overview: When The Looney Builders help Wile E. Coyote build a telescope to view the Looney Moon, Tweety must face his fear of the dark.

videos.title: Glamp Out
videos.overview: Gossamer invites The Looney Builders on a camping trip. They plan to build a simple campsite until Daffy insists they go "glamping" instead.

videos.title: Outer Space
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build Marvin the Martian and his Martian crew a space station. Marvin soon becomes overwhelmed by his Martian crew's antics and lack of personal space.

videos.title: The Great Flying Flea
videos.overview: The Looney Builders discover Zippy, an acrobatic flea, living on Sylvester's back. They build Zippy a flea circus to try and convince him to relocate.

videos.title: The Snuffles
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build an outdoor movie theater in the park. Lola is sick, but she doesn't want to admit it.

videos.title: Rainy Day
videos.overview: When it starts to rain outside, Porky hopes to show The Looney Builders that they can still have fun inside by building a fort.

videos.title: Bugs and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build a castle for Elmer the Giant. They admire his toys and use them without his permission.

videos.title: Jazz Hooves
videos.overview: Fosse Ferret hires The Looney Builders to build a stage for the kids’ dance recital. Eggbert has stage fright.

videos.title: Looney Games
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Mayor Leghorn to build the venue for the Looney Games. They soon become overwhelmed by the job and must ask for help.

videos.title: Roller Disco
videos.overview: Pete Puma hires The Looney Builders to build a roller disco for Looneyburg. Lola is new to roller skating but doesn’t want to practice.

videos.title: Grandpa Oink
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Petunia’s Grandpa Oink to upgrade his farm.

videos.title: Hare Ball
videos.overview: Marvin the Martian hires The Looney Builders to build an outer space ball court on Mars. Bugs is a big fan of the sport.

videos.title: Squeaky Clean
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build their headquarters a car wash. Daffy doesn’t want to wash Dumpy and goes to extreme lengths to keep him dirty.

videos.title: Prize Worthy Birdie
videos.overview: Sunny Seagull hires The Looney Builders to build a carnival on Looneyburg's pier.

videos.title: Cake Bake
videos.overview: The Looney Builders take turns distracting Petunia as they build her a big surprise birthday cake in the backyard.

videos.title: Porky Perfect Parade
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build a float to lead the Flower Parade, but Porky won't settle for anything less than Porky Perfect.

videos.title: Coaster Contest
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build a rollercoaster for Looneyburg.

videos.title: Sam's Stylin Salon
videos.overview: Sam Sheepdog hires The Looney Builders to build him a salon. Sam offers his custom cut only to learn that different folks want different styles.

videos.title: Polar Plunge
videos.overview: Pro snowboarder Pepper Polar Bear hires The Looney Builders to build a ski resort. Pepper soon learns that others have different skill levels.

videos.title: This Sand is Your Sand
videos.overview: Wile E. Coyote hires The Looney Builders to build him a house in the desert so he can be alone. The Road Runner tries to pay him a visit.

videos.title: Fire Fighters
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by the town’s volunteer firefighters to build a fire truck.

videos.title: Beignet Day
videos.overview: Zaida Gator hires The Looney Builders to build her a boat so she can share her beignets in the swamp.

videos.title: Pauleen's Pins
videos.overview: Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build an ice bowling alley in Looneyburg.

videos.title: Coconut Hut
videos.overview: While on vacation, The Looney Builders befriend Coco the Crab and offer to build her a mini-resort.

videos.title: Balloon Voyage
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac Gopher to build a hot air balloon for him and Tosh to ride in for a festival.

videos.title: Yosemite Sam's Dude Ranch⁩
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Yosemite Sam to build a dude ranch. Sam hurries the crew along, negatively impacting their work.

videos.title: Baseball Bunnies⁩
videos.overview: The Looney Builders build a baseball field, but both Bugs and Lola want to be the pitcher for the big game later.

videos.title: ⁨Spellbound⁩
videos.overview: Witch Hazel hires The Looney Builders to make her house look spooky for Halloween.

videos.title: Miss Prissy's Market⁩
videos.overview: Miss Prissy hires The Looney Builders to build a grocery store for Looneyburg.

videos.title: Super Builders⁩
videos.overview: The Looney Builders play superheroes and decide to upgrade their vehicles and headquarters. However one of Wile E. Coyote's inventions goes rogue.

videos.title: Dodo's Wacky Funhouse⁩
videos.overview: Yoyo Dodo hires The Looney Builders to build a funhouse for Looneyburg. The crew thinks he's goofing around as they work.

videos.title: Robo-Runner
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build a festive course for the Fall foot race. Wile E. Coyote is determined to beat the Road Runner.

videos.title: Cuckoo Cuckoo⁩
videos.overview: Curt Cuckoo hires The Looney Builders to build a giant cuckoo clock in Germany to signal the start of Martinstag.

videos.title: Surf's Up⁩
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired to build a surfside hangout in Australia for a surfing competition.

videos.title: ⁨Mamma Mia Pizzeria⁩
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Giovanna Badgerini to update her family’s pizzeria. However, Giovanna’s Mamma prefers the old way of doing things.

videos.title: Carnaval⁩
videos.overview: Carina Capybara hires The Looney Builders to build her Samba School a float for Brazil's Carnaval parade.

videos.title: Puppet Showstopper⁩
videos.overview: The Looney Builders are hired by Parth Peacock to build a puppet stage and puppets in India.

videos.title: Santa's Toyshop
videos.overview: After a hot cocoa disaster, Santa Claus hires The Looney Builders to build him a new toyshop in time to save Christmas.
